summary: Phase 3 complete: the backward (snce) half of the consistency conditions appended to FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/Realize.lean (249 -> 452 lines, +203), zero sorries, scoped guarded build green with zero errors and zero warnings. Eight new declarations -- SCoh, bwdDeferGraph, SLive, DischBwd, decidableSCoh, decidableSLive, persistBwd, disch_of_SCoh_SLive, u_of_dischBwd and the plan-pinned snce_iff_of_SCoh_SLive -- proved outright, with no symmetry transfer from the forward half and no declaration defined as an application of a Phase 2 one (UCoh/deferGraph/ULive occur inside the new section only in docstrings and comments). Axiom profile of all four new theorems is exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; Phase 2's untl_iff_of_UCoh_ULive re-pinned unchanged. Still generic over sig and Q: no model, no frame, no carrier finiteness anywhere. ONE DEVIATION, annotated inline in the plan and logged in issues.jsonl: bwdDeferGraph landed as the CONVERSE of the plan bullet's parenthetical spelling (fun x y => lab x u && !(lab x e) && step y x, not lab y u && !(lab y e) && step x y), because live/HasChain always ask for an infinite FORWARD chain, so the parenthetical hands live the forward graph -- equivalent acyclicity over a finite Q but only via cycle extraction, and not readable off persistBwd's backward stretch; the reversal is Present.lean's bwdLive precedent, and the same plan bullet's instruction to record which argument order of live is used and why is what makes the orientation a delegated choice. DischBwd was read side by side with LocalRun.snce: both the open interval (s, z) with s < z. typst/generated/status.typ regenerated per the pre-commit gate's remedy. The aggregator import edge is still deliberately absent (Phase 8 owns it). Single-phase dispatch: phases 4-8 remain; Phase 4 (PlusLanguage/Subformulas.lean, BoxStabFree) is territory-disjoint and Phase 5 (Cons, cons_localRun) is now unblocked but writes the same module, so 5-7 stay serialized.

continuation_context.note: phase_number was set to 3 for this dispatch; stopping as instructed. Note for any .lean-touching phase: FormalSystem.lean's import count stays one behind the file count until Phase 8 adds the aggregator edge, so typst-status-counts.sh's 670-vs-671 warning is expected and non-fatal, and each phase commit must stage a regenerated typst/generated/status.typ.
